caption: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Caring Pain Management, P.C.
citation_line: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Caring Pain Management, P.C., No. 2:22-cv-05017; rev'd, 98 F.4th 463 (3d Cir. 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Martinotti declined to compel arbitration of GEICO's New Jersey Insurance Fraud Prevention Act claim in litigation alleging fraudulent personal-injury-protection billing.
qualification_rationale: The consolidated appeal resolved whether IFPA claims are arbitrable and clarified both the breadth of New Jersey's PIP arbitration scheme and the Federal Arbitration Act's command once a valid agreement covers the dispute.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed in a precedential opinion and directed arbitration, holding that IFPA claims fall within the governing arbitration provisions.
